Package neqsim.process.equipment.compressor

Class CompressorShaftReport

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.compressor.CompressorShaftReport
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class CompressorShaftReport extends Object implements Serializable
Operating-point report of a CompressorShaft: the common speed, the driver power balance and, for every member, its speed, power, surge and stonewall margins, the discharge-pressure margin against the process need and the recycle fraction that anti-surge would have to carry. It is the Java counterpart of the member/state report of a Python shaft group and is meant for automation and MCP use (toJson()).

Flags per member use fixed wording so callers can test for them: "idle", "surge", "stonewall", "recycle required", "speed too low for the discharge need", "excess head (throttle or recycle)" and "outside member speed range".

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim Development Team

  • Constructor Details

    • CompressorShaftReport

      CompressorShaftReport(String shaftName, boolean turning, double speedRpm, double ambientTemperatureK, double totalPowerW, double requiredDriverPowerW, double availablePowerW, double powerUtilisation, boolean overPower, String solveStatus, boolean feasible, double driverFuelMassFlowKgPerHr, double driverExhaustTemperatureK, List<CompressorShaftReport.MemberReport> members)
      Constructor.
      Parameters:
      shaftName - name of the shaft
      turning - true when at least one member is active
      speedRpm - common shaft speed [rpm]
      ambientTemperatureK - ambient temperature used for the driver rating [K]
      totalPowerW - sum of the active member powers [W]
      requiredDriverPowerW - driver power including gearbox losses [W]
      availablePowerW - driver power available at the ambient temperature [W], 0 if unlimited
      powerUtilisation - required over available driver power, 0 if unlimited
      overPower - true when the required power exceeds the available power
      solveStatus - status of the last solve, or "NONE"
      feasible - feasibility of the last solve
      driverFuelMassFlowKgPerHr - driver fuel flow [kg/h], NaN without a gas turbine unit driver
      driverExhaustTemperatureK - driver exhaust temperature [K], NaN without a gas turbine unit driver
      members - member reports in flow order
